title: Playing in the houses with guitar and mandolin
summary: Dawson says houses mostly hired pianos; he sometimes went round with a rich young man's band; Frank Landry and others played there.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up a first guitar or banjo, self-taught

blocks.x: I had to leave the band, so I leave the boys' door and I got private. Yeah.
I didn't play in the houses. Yeah, that's right. Oh yeah, it first got famous on the piano then. You know the houses I played in? Yeah, Lou likes to know them a lot.
Did you ever play in any of the houses with your guitar too?

We used to go around with different bands sometimes, you know, like this fella, what you call it, Chester Moshe? No, I don't know about that. He was a young fella, you know, his daddy with a hat on, that big clothing store there, a dolphin. Well, he used to have plenty of money and he'd like good time. I was de Moshe. Yeah, he'd take us and get out on them good timers and go around them houses and take the band and go around.
What, is it just a small string group or bigger? Yeah, small.
And a big clothing store. Yeah, yeah.
Did any of the houses ever hire a guitar player? I know they usually have piano players. Oh yes, they used to hire a guitar player too.
No, they'd hire piano, most of them hire pianos. All pianos. Yeah, all pianos, yeah.
Was that uptown or downtown? Uptown, downtown.

That's the only fellas that I saw that would go in the house. That was, I don't know if you remember, Frank Landry? Yeah, Frank Landry. And you remember, Stael Brades? Stael Brades, yes. They used to keep running. Yeah, they'd go around. And Frank plays Marilyn. Marilyn and the... Yeah, Stael Brades plays guitar. Marilyn and the guitar. They'd sing, you know. They'd go in the house. They'd go in the house. They'd go in the house. The fellow that Brennan was there. Yeah, yeah, yeah. But Brennan was there having a good time, you know. Yeah, that's right. Big shots running around the house like that.
